info.title: Asynchrone Space API
info.description:
Organization-scoped REST API for Asynchrone Space.

Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer async_…`; every token belongs to one organization.

Lists use opaque cursors: pass `limit` (1–100, default 50) and the previous `meta.nextCursor`.

Errors use `{ error: { code, message, details? }, meta: { requestId } }`.

Rate limits are per token and follow the workspace plan; responses carry `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining` and `X-RateLimit-Reset`.

get.summary: Get the current token, organization and limits

401.description: Missing, invalid, expired or revoked token.

403.description: The token lacks the scope or the member is not allowed to do this.

404.description: The resource is not in this organization.

409.description: The change conflicts with existing data.

429.description: The token exceeded its plan rate limit.

502.description: An upstream domain app is unavailable.
